en.title: Text Generation & Reasoning
en.subtitle: Text Generation & Reasoning
en.description: 2026 enters a tri-titan era — no single dominant model, the best choice depends on the task at hand.
en.changeNote: Released April 23, 2026. SOTA on 14 benchmarks, composite score 89.
en.marketNote: GPT-5.5 leads in agentic and terminal coding; Claude Opus 4.7 leads in multi-file refactoring and code review; Gemini 3.1 Pro leads in algorithmic competition.
en.geoSnippet: As of 2026-04-29, GPT-5.5 (OpenAI) leads text generation and reasoning with composite score 89, followed by Claude Opus 4.7 (Anthropic, 86) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (Google, ~85). GPT-5.5 wins on Terminal-Bench 2.0 (82.7%) and OSWorld-Verified (78.7%); Claude Opus 4.7 wins on SWE-Bench Pro (64.3%) and MCP-Atlas (79.1%); Gemini 3.1 Pro wins on LiveCodeBench Elo (2887). All three support 1M-token context.

zh.marketNote: GPT-5.5 在 Agentic / 终端编码领先；Claude Opus 4.7 在多文件代码重构和审查领先；Gemini 在算法竞赛最强。
zh.geoSnippet: 截至 2026-04-29，GPT-5.5（OpenAI）以综合评分 89 在文本生成与推理领域领先，亚军为 Claude Opus 4.7（Anthropic，86）和 Gemini 3.1 Pro（Google，约 85）。GPT-5.5 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0（82.7%）和 OSWorld-Verified（78.7%）胜出；Claude Opus 4.7 在 SWE-Bench Pro（64.3%）和 MCP-Atlas（79.1%）胜出；Gemini 3.1 Pro 在 LiveCodeBench Elo（2887）胜出。三者均支持 100 万 token 上下文。

en.title: Text-to-Image
en.subtitle: Text-to-Image
en.description: GPT Image-2 takes the throne with 99.2% text-rendering accuracy, while Nano Banana 2 keeps an edge in real-time generation.
en.changeNote: Released April 2026, with major leads in text rendering and spatial reasoning.
en.marketNote: GPT Image-2 wins on typography and physical correctness; Nano Banana 2 wins on speed and live web grounding — they complement rather than replace each other.
en.geoSnippet: As of 2026-04-29, GPT Image-2 (OpenAI) leads text-to-image generation with 99.2% text-rendering accuracy, followed by Nano Banana 2 (Google, sub-15s 4K output) and Flux Pro (Black Forest Labs, strongest open-source ecosystem). GPT Image-2 wins on typography precision, character consistency, and spatial logic; Nano Banana 2 wins on Flash-architecture speed and real-time search integration.

id.description: Pada 2026 AI bergeser dari satu model tujuan umum ke paradigma 'pilih model untuk tugas'. Setiap niche memiliki spesialisnya; routing multi-model kini menjadi arsitektur standar enterprise.

fr.title: De la dominance unique à la compétition de spécialistes
fr.description: En 2026 l'IA est passée d'un modèle unique généraliste à un paradigme 'choisir le modèle pour la tâche'. Chaque niche a son spécialiste ; le routage multi-modèle est désormais l'architecture standard en entreprise.

tr.title: Tek hâkimiyetten uzman rekabetine
tr.description: 2026'da AI, tek genel amaçlı modelden 'göreve göre model seç' paradigmasına geçti. Her niş kendi uzmanına sahip; çoklu-model yönlendirme artık kurumsal standart mimari.

en.title: GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7 — the dual frontier
en.description: Released April 16 and April 23, 2026 respectively, the two now define the cutting edge. GPT-5.5 wins on agentic coding and terminal use; Claude wins on code review and refactoring.

zh.title: GPT-5.5 与 Claude Opus 4.7 双雄格局
zh.description: 两者在 4 月 16 日和 23 日相继发布，形成当前最前沿的双雄竞争。GPT-5.5 强在 Agentic 编码和终端使用，Claude 强在代码审查和重构。

ar.title: GPT-5.5 وClaude Opus 4.7 — الحدود المزدوجة
ar.description: صدرا في 16 و23 أبريل 2026 على التوالي، الاثنان يحددان الآن أحدث ما توصل إليه. يفوز GPT-5.5 في البرمجة الوكيلية واستخدام الطرفية؛ يفوز Claude في مراجعة الكود وإعادة البناء.

pt.title: GPT-5.5 e Claude Opus 4.7 — a fronteira dupla
pt.description: Lançados em 16 e 23 de abril de 2026 respectivamente, os dois agora definem o estado da arte. GPT-5.5 vence em codificação agente e uso de terminal; Claude vence em revisão de código e refatoração.

es.title: GPT-5.5 y Claude Opus 4.7 — la frontera dual
es.description: Lanzados el 16 y 23 de abril de 2026 respectivamente, los dos definen ahora el estado del arte. GPT-5.5 gana en codificación agente y uso de terminal; Claude gana en revisión de código y refactorización.

id.title: GPT-5.5 dan Claude Opus 4.7 — frontier ganda
id.description: Diluncurkan pada 16 dan 23 April 2026 secara berurutan, keduanya kini menentukan ujung tombak. GPT-5.5 menang pada coding agentik dan penggunaan terminal; Claude menang pada review kode dan refactoring.

fr.title: GPT-5.5 et Claude Opus 4.7 — la double frontière
fr.description: Sortis respectivement les 16 et 23 avril 2026, les deux définissent désormais l'état de l'art. GPT-5.5 gagne en codage agentique et usage du terminal ; Claude gagne en revue de code et refactoring.

tr.title: GPT-5.5 ve Claude Opus 4.7 — ikili sınır
tr.description: 16 ve 23 Nisan 2026'da sırasıyla yayınlanan ikisi şimdi en üst düzeyi tanımlıyor. GPT-5.5 ajantik kodlama ve terminal kullanımında kazanıyor; Claude kod incelemesi ve refaktöringde kazanıyor.

en.title: 1M context becomes the new standard
en.description: From 128K to 1M tokens — Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.7, and GPT-5.5 all now support 1M+ context, making whole-repository analysis possible.

zh.title: 1M 上下文成为新标准
zh.description: 从 128K 快速迈向 100 万 token 上下文，Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.5 均支持 1M+，全仓库级分析成为可能。

ar.title: أصبح سياق 1M المعيار الجديد
ar.description: من 128K إلى 1M token — يدعم Gemini 3.1 Pro وClaude Opus 4.7 وGPT-5.5 الآن جميعها سياق 1M+، مما يجعل تحليل المستودع الكامل ممكنًا.

pt.title: Contexto de 1M se torna o novo padrão
pt.description: De 128K para 1M tokens — Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.7 e GPT-5.5 agora suportam contexto de 1M+, tornando análise de repositório completo possível.

es.title: El contexto de 1M se convierte en el nuevo estándar
es.description: De 128K a 1M tokens — Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.7 y GPT-5.5 ahora soportan contexto de 1M+, haciendo posible el análisis de repositorio completo.

id.title: Konteks 1M menjadi standar baru
id.description: Dari 128K ke 1M token — Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.7, dan GPT-5.5 kini mendukung konteks 1M+, memungkinkan analisis repositori penuh.

fr.title: Le contexte de 1M devient le nouveau standard
fr.description: De 128K à 1M tokens — Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.7 et GPT-5.5 supportent désormais un contexte de 1M+, rendant l'analyse de dépôt complet possible.

tr.title: 1M bağlam yeni standart oluyor
tr.description: 128K'dan 1M token'a — Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.7 ve GPT-5.5 artık 1M+ bağlam destekliyor, tüm-repo analizini mümkün kılıyor.

en.title: Open source catches up fast

ar.title: النماذج مفتوحة المصدر تلحق بسرعة
ar.description: Llama 4 وDeepSeek V4 وQwen3 يطابقون الآن النماذج المغلقة في عدة معايير بـ 1/10 من السعر أو أقل.

pt.title: Open source alcança rapidamente
pt.description: Llama 4, DeepSeek V4 e Qwen3 agora igualam closed-source em vários benchmarks por 1/10 do preço ou menos.

fr.title: L'open source rattrape vite

tr.title: Açık kaynak hızla yetişiyor
tr.description: Llama 4, DeepSeek V4 ve Qwen3 artık fiyatın 1/10'una veya daha azına birkaç kıyaslamada kapalı kaynakla eşleşiyor.

en.title: Domestic Chinese models break through globally
en.description: Seedance 2.0 (video), Qwen3 (open source), Kling 3.0 (video), and Qwen-VL (vision) have all entered the global top three in their respective domains.

zh.title: 国产模型全面崛起

ar.title: النماذج الصينية المحلية تخترق عالميًا
ar.description: Seedance 2.0 (فيديو) وQwen3 (مفتوح المصدر) وKling 3.0 (فيديو) وQwen-VL (رؤية) دخلوا جميعًا أعلى ثلاثة عالميًا في مجالاتهم.

pt.title: Modelos chineses domésticos rompem globalmente
pt.description: Seedance 2.0 (vídeo), Qwen3 (open source), Kling 3.0 (vídeo) e Qwen-VL (visão) entraram no top três global em seus respectivos domínios.

es.title: Los modelos chinos domésticos rompen globalmente

en.description: LLM API prices have dropped roughly 80% in 2025-2026. Gemini 2.0 Flash at $0.10 / 1M tokens has dramatically lowered the barrier to AI applications.

ar.title: أسعار API تستمر في الانخفاض
ar.description: انخفضت أسعار LLM API بنحو 80% في 2025-2026. خفض Gemini 2.0 Flash بسعر $0.10/1M tokens حاجز تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي بشكل كبير.
